title: Per-ayah timings of one surah (the apps' SurahAyahTimings)
description: timings/<reciter>/<NNN>.json, folded from the word alignment by ayah_timings.py: each ayah's first reading in recitation order; missing ayahs bridged from neighbours; spans never overlap. Starts are a median 110 ms late (p95 350 ms) against the audio: the apps seek 350 ms before start_ms (never before the previous ayah's end) and fade in.

end_ms.description: ≥ start_ms; equal only for an ayah the aligner never heard, bridged between neighbours that touch.
